services.desc: TaeKwonDo, a well-rounded martial art that originated in Korea, combines combat and self-defense techniques with sport and exercise. It is one of the most popular and widely practiced martial arts in the world today and has been a part of the Olympic Games since 2000. Training in Taekwondo is an excellent tool for physical fitness and character development for children. Many students have journeyed from beginning white belts to black belts. This class provides a challenging and fun workout while also learning a practical skill that can improve fitness, coordination, self-defense, and self-confidence.
